title: Advice complexity of sublanguages of all ones
statement: Let $L$ be a language of finite binary words. If every word in $L$ consists entirely of ones, then there is a natural number $c$ such that a finite Turing machine decides $L$ with advice of exactly one bit at each input length and running time at most $c(n+1)$ on inputs of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: L is a language of binary words
L is contained in the language of all-ones words
